info.name: HSTS Manager
info.summary: Add a configurable HSTS header to HTTPS response
info.description:
Add HSTS (HTTP Strict Transport Security) header to HTTPS response, if modheaders is not available. Configurable via config.php or the admin settings GUI.
This is a fork of "HSTS Header" by Klaus Herberth (sualko), now maintained by Andreas Weller (DF1PAW).
info.author: Andreas Weller, DF1PAW
